top_cards.title: Personal data breach notification (Art. 33) (D-04.3 / GDPR)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — Adopt EDPB 9/2022 precautionary reading. Notification required unless certainty-of-no-risk. 72h from awareness (DORA 4h satisfies all shorter clocks)

top_cards.title: Security measures (open list) (D-09.1 / GDPR)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — Adopt industry standard reading (ISO 27001 + sector-specific best practices). NIST CSF 2.0 mapping as the structured reading.

top_cards.title: Privacy by design (D-01.1 / GDPR)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — Adopt industry standard reading. Art. 25(1) by-design necessity assessment + 4-factor proportionality.

top_cards.title: General controller responsibility (D-09.1 / GDPR)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — Adopt EDPB 07/2019 material-change trigger. ISO 27001 surveillance + DORA Art. 5 framework update.

top_cards.title: 72-hour notification (D-06.3 cross-cut) (D-06.3 / GDPR)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — Adopt EDPB 9/2022 72h hard cap. 4h DORA clock satisfies all shorter deadlines.

top_cards.title: Supply-chain due diligence (Q6=b split) (D-06.1 / CRA)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R3 — Both procedural + substantive. DORA Art. 28 pre-contractual assessment + Art. 30 CTPP register + quarterly critical-vendor review.

top_cards.title: Cybersecurity risk-assessment core duty (D-09.2 / CRA)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R3 — Both. IPSARA Unified Assessment Framework (T-003 RESOLVED) discharges all 5 assessment obligations.

top_cards.title: Important-products classification gate (D-09.3 / CRA)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R3 — Substantial. Mobile banking app is Standard/Default class (not Important/Critical). Self-declaration of conformity suffices.

top_cards.title: Contractual arrangements (DORA-style) (D-06.3 / CRA)
top_cards.article: Annex I Part II + DORA Art. 30
top_cards.recommended_variant: R2 — DORA-grade CTPP clauses + AI Act Art. 25 downstream provider obligations. 100% critical vendor contracts with CTPP clauses.

top_cards.title: Risk-management core obligation (D-09.3 / NIS 2)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R3 — Compound qualifier. Art. 21(2)(a)-(j) closed-AND-list reading. CRO + CISO owns.

top_cards.title: Incident notification (Art. 23(4)) (D-04.3 / NIS 2)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — DORA 4h satisfies all shorter deadlines. Single incident record → per-regulation router → BaFin + ECB + CSIRT + ENISA + DPA + AI Office.

top_cards.title: Management body liability (Art. 20) (D-08.3 / NIS 2)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R2 — Substantive. Board briefing programme mandatory (annual) + personal liability acknowledged in writing + DORA Art. 5(2) 4-verb coordination.

top_cards.title: Coordinated vulnerability disclosure ecosystem (D-02.3 / NIS 2)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — security.txt + dedicated intake mailbox + CVD page + ISO 29147 process. Bug bounty deferred.

top_cards.title: Threat-Led Penetration Testing (Art. 26) (D-02.4 / DORA)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — 3y baseline + ECB frequency adjustment. T-005 RESOLVED: parallel cycles with unified scope + findings tracking.

top_cards.title: Critical ICT third-party contracts (Art. 30) (D-06.3 / DORA)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — OJ-literal. 100% critical vendor contracts with CTPP clauses + audit rights + exit strategies for CIF.

top_cards.title: ICT risk management framework (Art. 5) (D-09.1 / DORA)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — 4 separate duties. Board briefing programme + 5-policy architecture + ISMS surveillance audit + DORA Art. 5 framework documented.

top_cards.title: ICT-related incident management process (Art. 17) (D-04.1 / DORA)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — 3 separate duties. 24/7 SOC + SIEM + SOAR + EDR + NDR + UEBA + 5-reg max-SLA routing pipeline.

top_cards.title: Risk management system (Annex III High-Risk) (D-09.1 / AI Act)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R1 — Continuous lifecycle. IPSARA Unified Assessment Framework (T-003 RESOLVED) integrates AI Act Art. 9 + DORA Art. 5 + GDPR DPIA + CRA + NIS 2.

top_cards.title: Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA) (D-09.2 / AI Act)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R2 — IPSARA Unified Assessment Framework. Single underlying assessment, per-regulation output stream.

top_cards.title: Post-market monitoring (Art. 72) (D-10.1 / AI Act)
top_cards.recommended_variant: R2 — Active continuous monitoring. 24/7 SOC + SIEM + AI model monitoring integrated with security monitoring.
